title: Scrum card, v0
description: One task on a project's scrum board (atlas/scrum/board.json, RFC 0234). A card is a Trello card with the fields an agent needs to build it: the docs it follows, the code it extends, its checklist, how it is accepted and tested, and its dates. Its id becomes the InOrbit Planner item id when it is claimed, so it follows the Planner's id rules.

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes; the Planner item id.

list.description: The Trello list. Planner status: backlog is proposed, ready is ready, doing and review are building, done is done, dropped is dropped.

labels.description: Free tags for finding and grouping cards. Anything project-specific beyond a tag goes in x.

x.description: Free-form fields a project adds to its cards, such as x.section or x.ideas. The schema does not look inside; the project's own tooling does.

size.description: S is under 3 hours of agent time, M 3 to 8, L more than 8.

hours.description: Planned agent hours, building and testing.

depends_on.description: Card ids that must be done first.

blocked_by.description: Things outside the board it waits for: an approval id, a core or SDK pull request, an owner decision.

docs.description: Paths under atlas/ of the documents the card follows.

builds_on.description: Existing code it extends, as path or path::name. Nothing is built twice.

acceptance.description: What must be true to move it to done.

tests.description: The grouped tests that prove it.

planner.description: The InOrbit Planner plan and item ids, written back by iohr atlas scrum sync. Core plan ids (plan_...) and item slugs use A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _, . and -.

notes.description: Dated lines, oldest first: moved due dates, forced moves, evidence for done.
